supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate extension of the brow ridge boundary beyond the lateral canthi of the eyes.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-toned muzzle area and the dark-toned periocular and forehead skin.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness of the lower lip in a neutral structural position.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical midline crease or light-colored hair parting is visible on the center of the forehead.
